n_3dbd43b145ee140c.name: Set summary details
n_3dbd43b145ee140c.source: export default function config({sender,recipient,cc}){const email=/^[^\s<>@,]+@[^\s<>@,]+\.[^\s<>@,]+$/;if(typeof sender!=='string'||!email.test(sender)||sender==='sender@example.com'||typeof recipient!=='string'||!email.test(recipient)||recipient==='recipient@example.com'||!Array.isArray(cc)||cc.some(x=>typeof x!=='string'||!email.test(x)))throw Error('Configure sender and recipient email addresses');const until=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000),since=until-86400;return{query:`from:${sender} after:${since} before:${until}`,recipient,cc,since,until}}

n_7dd2ec923c92e001.name: Collect matching message IDs
n_7dd2ec923c92e001.source: export default function pages({previous,messages,nextPageToken}){let s=previous??{ids:[],cursors:[],pages:0};if(messages!=null){if(!Array.isArray(messages)||messages.some(m=>typeof m?.messageId!=='string'||!m.messageId))throw Error('Invalid Gmail page');const ids=[...s.ids,...messages.map(x=>x.messageId)];if(new Set(ids).size!==ids.length||ids.length>5000)throw Error('Duplicate or excessive Gmail results');if(nextPageToken!==null&&typeof nextPageToken!=='string')throw Error('Invalid Gmail cursor');if(nextPageToken&&s.cursors.includes(nextPageToken))throw Error('Repeated Gmail cursor');s={ids,cursors:nextPageToken?[...s.cursors,nextPageToken]:s.cursors,pages:s.pages+1};if(s.pages>=100&&nextPageToken)throw Error('Gmail page limit reached');return{state:s,more:!!nextPageToken,pageToken:nextPageToken||null,ids:s.ids}}return{state:s,more:true,pageToken:null,ids:s.ids}}

n_2fc4cbb033b0e6a1.name: Collect email headers and snippets
n_2fc4cbb033b0e6a1.source: export default function next({ids,previous,messageIdReceived,payload,snippet}){if(!Array.isArray(ids)||ids.length>5000)throw Error('Invalid Gmail IDs');let s=previous??{index:0,entries:[]};if(messageIdReceived!=null){if(s.index>=ids.length||messageIdReceived!==ids[s.index])throw Error('Gmail message association failed');const headers=payload?.headers??[];if(!Array.isArray(headers))throw Error('Invalid message headers');const read=name=>headers.filter(h=>typeof h?.name==='string'&&h.name.toLowerCase()===name).map(h=>h.value).filter(v=>typeof v==='string').join(', ');s={index:s.index+1,entries:[...s.entries,{id:messageIdReceived,from:read('from'),to:read('to'),cc:read('cc'),snippet:(snippet??'').replace(/&|<|>|'|"/g,x=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>',''':"'",'"':'"'}[x]))}]}}if(s.entries.length!==s.index||s.index>ids.length)throw Error('Invalid progress');return{state:s,more:s.index<ids.length,messageId:ids[s.index]??'',prompt:JSON.stringify(s.entries),count:s.entries.length}}

n_782396b6306208a1.name: Prepare the summary email
n_782396b6306208a1.source:
export default function format({result,recipient,cc}){if(!result||!Array.isArray(result.summary_of_emails)||!Array.isArray(result.actions)||result.summary_of_emails.some(x=>typeof x!=='string')||result.actions.some(x=>!x||typeof x.name!=='string'||typeof x.action!=='string'))throw Error('Invalid summary');const esc=x=>x.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"');const html='

Email summary

Summary

    '+result.summary_of_emails.map(x=>'
  • '+esc(x)+'
    • ').join('')+'

Actions

    '+result.actions.map(x=>'
  • '+esc(x.name)+': '+esc(x.action)+'
    • ').join('')+'
';if(html.length>500000)throw Error('Summary too large');return{to:recipient,cc,subject:'Daily Gmail summary',body:html}}

n_010e60aa7e9f4d80.name: Confirm the sent message
n_010e60aa7e9f4d80.source: export default function confirm({messageId}){if(typeof messageId!=="string"||!messageId)throw Error("Gmail did not confirm sending");return {messageId}}
